title: Dreadmist Peak
wikitext:
[[File:Dreadmist Peak.jpg|thumb|Dreadmist Peak.]]

'''Dreadmist Peak''' is a mountain northwest of the [[Crossroads]] in the [[Northern Barrens]]. As you climb to the top of the Peak, the atmosphere becomes red and foggy. At the top is the home of a group of [[Burning Blade clan|Burning Blade]] cultists. They protect the [[:Demon Seed]] which is in the [[Dreadmist Den]].

The orange miasma is residuum from an ancient [[demon]]ic curse.<ref>''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 20, pg. 207</ref>

==Cycle of Hatred==
{{novel-section}}
Three years after the [[Third War]], [[Jaina Proudmoore]], [[Aegwynn]], and [[Lorena|Colonel Lorena]] confronted the demon [[Zmodlor]] here after he tried to start a war between the Horde and [[Theramore (nation)|Theramore]]. The group fought many [[grell]]kin minions and [[warlock]]s of the Burning Blade here, but in the end Jaina and Aegwynn together were able to banish the demon.<ref>''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 22, pg. 228 - 232</ref>

==How to get there==
To get there from the Crossroads, head north along the road until you get to a fork. Face northwest and you will see Dreadmist Peak looming before you.

*[[Burning Blade Acolyte]]

*[[Sarilus Foulborne]]

==Notes==
*An undead mage named [[Sarilus Foulborne]] sits atop the Peak. He used his powers to control [[Befouled Water Elemental]]s in [[Ashenvale]]. Alliance characters confronted him in the quest [[Mage Summoner]].
*[[Rathorian]], the leader of this group of Burning Blade cultists, is sometimes inside the Dreadmist Den.
*[[Tauren]] [[druid]]s needed to get a sample of water from the peak that was believed to poison the gazelles of the Barrens.<ref>[[The Principal Source]]</ref>
